title: Make lifecycle gates subject-safe, optional-aware, and release-complete
goal: Prevent lifecycle progress and release approval from being inferred from unscoped, optional, or incomplete gate state.
in_scope: Make gate.mjs reject bare check calls for G6 and G7 with an actionable --subject message
Make gate.mjs next omit pending G1.5 because assumption validation is optional
Strengthen the release skill gate-in to check G1 through G5 and each release epic's subject-scoped G7 approval
Update CLI and skill regression coverage for the stricter gate contract
out_of_scope: Changing the meaning or approval ownership of G1 through G9
acceptance: Bare G6 and G7 checks exit non-zero with an actionable --subject error; gate next skips optional G1.5 when it is pending; and the release skill requires approved G1 through G5 plus subject-scoped G7 approval for every epic in the release before presenting G8.
invariants: G6 and G7 approvals remain independently stored per subject
G1.5 remains visible in list output even when next skips it
G8 is never presented while an applicable upstream lifecycle gate is pending or rejected
